No entry offer

Readers leave without a trace

Someone who saves your post on people-pleasing but isn’t ready to sign up has nothing to opt into. You can’t follow up with people you never captured.

No first purchase

Most of your audience can’t say yes yet

Many people reading about burnout and self-worth aren’t ready for a full coaching program. With nothing smaller to buy, they don’t buy anything.

All organic

Every lead depends on the next post

5,701 posts is a huge amount of giving. But organic reach is linear: the week you rest is the week your calendar goes quiet.

Anyone not ready for coaching today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

Questions

Before you grab your seat

Who is this for?

Anyone tired of over-giving, people-pleasing and running on empty, who keeps ending up in the same draining relationship patterns.

What do I get for $17?

The 60-minute live class on Zoom, The Reset Workbook (printable PDF), 7-day replay access and the live Q&A with Ana Maria.

What if I can’t make it live?

Every seat includes the replay for 7 days, so you can watch when it suits you.

Is this therapy?

No. This is an educational coaching class. It is not therapy and does not replace support from a licensed professional.

Do I have to share anything on the call?

No. You can keep your camera off and simply listen and take notes.

What happens after I sign up?

You’ll land on a short page with three steps: check your inbox, reply “YES” to the email so the class link reaches you, and add the class to your calendar.

Script 1: “It’s not that you don’t know better”

Talking to camera · 30 to 45 seconds · 9:16 reel

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Most people stuck in draining relationships already know what they ‘should’ do. That isn’t the problem.”

Body

“The problem is the pattern underneath: saying yes when you mean no, giving until there’s nothing left, and feeling guilty the moment you put yourself first. Patterns like that are learned, which means they can be changed, one small choice at a time.”

CTA

“I’m teaching the 4 shifts I use with my clients in a live 60-minute class. Seats are $17 and include the replay. Tap Sign up to save yours.”

Shot: soft natural light, Ana Maria speaking to camera, on-screen caption of the hook in white on plum. Disclaimer in caption: educational coaching content, not therapy.

Script 2: “Three words that change everything”

Talking to camera · 30 seconds · 9:16 reel

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Here are three words that make boundaries so much easier: ‘Let me think.’”

Body

“People-pleasers answer instantly. ‘Let me think’ buys you space to check in with yourself before you agree to something you’ll resent. It’s one of the scripts I share in my live class, along with a simple plan for the next 30 days.”

CTA

“If you want the rest, join The Self-Worth Reset. It’s $17, live, and the replay is included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: on-screen text “Let me think.” appears in a lavender box as she says it. Caption ends with the disclaimer.

Script 3: “Tired even on the quiet days?”

Talking to camera · 40 seconds · 9:16 reel

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Ever feel exhausted on a day when nothing big even happened?”

Body

“A lot of that tiredness comes from tiny leaks: over-explaining, holding everyone else’s feelings, never saying what you need. In my live class I show you how to notice those leaks early and the small daily resets that help.”

CTA

“The Self-Worth Reset is live, 60 minutes and $17. Tap Sign up and I’ll see you there.”

Shot: opens on a slow sip of tea, then cut to talking head. Keep the tone warm, not dramatic. Disclaimer in caption.
